patch_list: Removes the ad banners, native ads, sticky ads and full-screen ads, and the ads on cnnindonesia.com pages opened in the app.
Shows every page of a multi-page article in one continuous article, without the page numbers.
Adds the themed app icon of Android 13 and later, which follows the wallpaper colors.
